impact.text: First depositor instantly controls ~100 % of shares for negligible cost.

precondition_sources.text: HypoVault pre-sets totalSupply = 1 000 000 in the constructor.
At bootstrap the vault owns zero underlying assets.
Before the first fulfilment, computeNAV() == assetsDeposited so totalAssets == 1.

intent_sources.text: Shares should be minted only when assets exist; for the very first deposit, sharesReceived should equal assetsToFulfill.
The vault should start with zero supply rather than a hard-coded totalSupply while owning zero assets.
